proposal.rationale: The requested change is expressible with the reviewed execution primitive set and supplied numeric.search-seed tool binding. The proposed campaign preserves the exact seed invocation, exact parameters artifact, and result export, while adding the required predecessor checkpoint passthrough as a root input and root output. This step addresses the campaign-design question of how to revise a deterministic synthetic search graph so that the predecessor checkpoint can be carried forward without altering the installed tool binding or asserting any scientific outcome.
